subject: Spectra renewal & expansion — recap and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Green <claire.green@spectraanalytics.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@spectraanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spectra renewal & expansion — recap and next steps

Hi Claire / Raj —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and agreed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of pain points we heard:
- Increased latency and cost for your new real-time ingestion pipeline (spikes during business hours).
- Delta between research/dev Prompts and production prompts causing quality regressions when scaling.
- Need for stronger audit logs and data partitioning for compliance with your internal policies.

Goals you outlined:
1) Reduce median tail latency for the ingestion path to <150ms per token.
2) Lower per-token cost for bulk nightly batches by ~30%.
3) Enable private deployment options for regulated workloads (auditability + KMS).

Current usage snapshot (high level):
- 1.2B tokens / month (increasing 25% q/q)
- Heavy peak usage 10–2pm PST on weekdays

Proposal / upsell path we discussed:
- Upgrade to a Dedicated pool for steady-state production inference (predictable throughput + lower p95s).
- Add a separate Dedicated pool for the real-time ingestion path (isolated capacity).
- Apply prefix/KV caching and optimized batching for nightly bulk jobs to reduce cost.
- Plan a Private deployment pilot for regulated workloads (audit logs + KMS).

Immediate next steps (agreed):
- I’ll send the usage report and a draft SOW with ballpark pricing by EOD Friday (Ben).
- Monica will schedule a technical deep-dive next week to scope the Dedicated sizing (Monica).
- Claire / Raj to confirm internal procurement timeline and any procurement constraints.

If I missed anything, call it out — otherwise I’ll follow up with the attachments and draft pricing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Thanks Ben — that matches our notes. A couple clarifications: 

- The ingestion spikes are the highest priority; if we can isolate that traffic and guarantee lower p95s we can justify the Dedicated pool.
- We’ll need the preliminary pricing to present to finance by next Thursday (6/18).
- For the Private deployment pilot, security will need SOC 2 and an outline of encryption key management (KMS) integration.

I’m including Marissa as she’ll own the renewal coordination on our side. Please send the usage report and draft SOW when ready.
